cases.policy:
schema_version="0.1.0"
[session]
scope="conversation"
[policy.rulepacks]
bundled=["core"]
[[rule]]
kind="default"
action="tokenize"
[ner]
model_dir="/synthetic/ner"
[dob_judge]
enabled=true
model_dir="/synthetic/dob"
[safety_net]
backend="nym"
[safety_net.nym]
model_dir="/synthetic/nym"

schema_version="0.1.0"
[session]
scope="conversation"
[policy.rulepacks]
bundled=["core"]

action="tokenize"

kind="regex"
name="synthetic-order"
class="custom:order_id"
pattern="^SYNTH-[0-9]+$"
